capabilities: open a preview popup by clicking an image in a note
zoom, pan, and switch between fit and 1:1 views
navigate previous/next images with a thumbnail gallery
pin multiple previews simultaneously for image comparison
interact via mobile gestures, keyboard shortcuts, and commands
extras: README is written in Chinese with an English manifest description; interface language is configurable (Chinese/English/follow system). Requires Obsidian 1.8.7+ and works on desktop and mobile.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to inspect embedded images closely; clicking an image gives no zoom, pan, or multi-image comparison.
summary: Popup image previewer that opens a zoomable, pannable preview window when you click an image in a note, with pin mode, gallery, and mobile gestures.
